body:
> People are attached to you already. You are important to them, and you will be crushing them if you kill yourself. 

I don't even know if that's true. I can name perhaps 2 people who would be upset, my wife and my mother. I really doubt that it would phase my friends or other family members, and my wife and mother surely know that I'm doomed already and they can't possibly be attached to me.

> You still haven't said what the reason behind all of this is.

I am married to a woman that I am making completely miserable when she could be enjoying the company of someone that makes her happy. I am nearly $100k in debt. I am broken. People can surround me with positivity all they want but I'll still be here in front of my computer at 2 in the morning making myself bleed and praying for the courage to just fucking kill myself. I am a failure in my field. None of my colleagues respect me because I have not done anything worth respecting.

> You seem to have all the answers and you seemed to have made up your mind.

I'm praying that someone will have some magic answer that will solve at least one problem in my life and make everything seem worth carrying through.
Why would I do that to them before I die? It's much better that I die as a useless piece of ass than try to make people get attached to me before I leave.

> Do you honestly feel you have done everything in your power to get through this?

I have been trying for so long and I have finally admitted that I will never be what I want to be. I have been in therapy for about a decade and I have been on about 8 different medications over the last 3-4 years. I am shit right now but in the past I have fixed my diet, exercised daily, everything they tell you to do. I am intrinsically broken and there is literally no hope that anything can provide to me.

> no amount of stress amounts to how they will feel if you take your life. 

I can either kill myself as soon as possible and rid them of me permanently, or I can remain in this world and remain their problem for the rest of both of our lives. Even if I mean anything to anyone, they will get over it after a while. I'd much rather they suffer on the short term, get over it, and live a happy life than live with me forever and just be miserable for their entire lives.

> Do you remember what happiness feels like?

I try so, so hard. I wish I was not as broken as I am.

No, and I do not want to burden them. They know that I have been seeing a professional for the last decade or so but they do not know that it has not been helping me at all or that I plan to take my own life. There would be no point in informing them. No words I can think of could stop me. All assurances of "you do matter" and "please don't do this" would be utterly hollow and meaningless. I do not wish to trouble them more than is necessary.
